label: E-7 basic annual wage requirement, professional (E-7-1)
appliesTo: E-7 specific activities status holders and the employers sponsoring them
why: The basis changed, not just the number. E-7 wage requirements were long explained as a percentage of the previous year's per-capita GNI, and that formula is still repeated everywhere — but the Ministry of Justice now announces amounts by sub-type directly, with a stated period of application. Anyone computing a figure from GNI is answering a question that is no longer asked, and certain occupations set their own requirement on top.

history.source: Ministry of Justice — 2026 E-7 wage requirement announcement
history.note: E-7-1 professional. The same announcement sets E-7-2 semi-professional and E-7-3 general skilled at ₩25,890,000, and E-7-4 skilled technical at ₩26,000,000. It applies from 1 February to 31 December 2026. Where an occupation-specific notice or guideline sets its own wage requirement — some still keyed to a share of GNI — that requirement governs instead.
